summary_en: HIDAY HIDAKA executed a block buyback of 1,178,000 shares (3.27% of issued shares excluding treasury shares) at ¥2,971 per share on October 5, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3, for a total of ¥3.5 billion. The company aims to respond flexibly to changes in the operating environment through its capital management strategy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading System (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 2, 2026, the Board of Directors of HIDAY HIDAKA Corp. authorized a single block buyback execution of treasury stock via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading, to be executed on October 5, 2026 at 8:45 AM on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The company will purchase a maximum of 1,178,000 shares at the closing price of October 2, 2026, which was ¥2,971 per share. The total maximum purchase amount is ¥3.5 billion. This represents 3.27% of issued shares excluding treasury shares as of August 31, 2026 (36,015,972 shares outstanding). The order is limited to the specified trading session and will be fulfilled on a best-effort basis depending on market conditions.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to execute flexible capital management policies in response to changes in the operating environment. The company disclosed that Tadashi Kanda, the Chairman and Representative Director, has indicated an intention to sell a portion of his shares. Depending on the buyback results, there may be changes in the company's major shareholders and representative structure, which will be disclosed promptly if they occur.
